_comment: Versioned, repository-owned PROMOTE_SCOPE first-promotion bootstrap-authorization manifest. See native_short_promotion_bootstrap_evidence_v1.py for the full contract. v2 generalizes the file's shape from one hardcoded scope to a reviewed list of independently-evidenced entries -- each entry authorizes exactly one PROMOTE_SCOPE for its own named scope, and only for a scope that has never before had any administration-ledger row (structurally single-use -- see native_short_scope_administration_transaction_v1._bootstrap_promotion_evidence_applies). No entry is a wildcard: every scope field is a fixed literal, no two entries may name the same symbol, and an entry cannot authorize a second promotion of its own scope once the first succeeds. Each entry's approved_implementation_commit names an already-existing, ordinary historical commit that introduced the reviewed bootstrap mechanism that entry's approval trusts; it is verified as an ancestor of the current checkout (never compared for exact HEAD equality -- that remains the unmodified job of the existing repository-source-identity and writer-capability-authorization boundaries). Each entry's approval_evidence_digest binds its own accepted+scope+approval_reference+approved_at_utc+approved_implementation_commit+the current SHA-256 of native_short_promotion_bootstrap_evidence_v1.py together; editing any of those fields, or the evidence module itself, without recomputing that entry's digest fails its evaluation closed.
